title: Sahih al-Bukhari - Hadith 1
text: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "من كذب علي متعمدا فليتبوأ مقعده من النار"
original: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "من كذب علي متعمدا فليتبوأ مقعده من النار"

title: Hanafi position on raising hands in salah
text: Generally accepted at the beginning of the prayer at takbir and at the start of bowing in the Hanafi school.

title: Ibn Baz - Fatwa on Raising Hands
text: The scholar discussed the Sunnah of beginning prayer with the takbir and raising the hands according to the evidence.
